verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an API reference overview and a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec. That spec is a building block a user could load into an external tool, not an interactive reference with runnable examples. Nothing in the pack shows an in-docs 'try it' console, an API playground, or executable request examples, so the story's core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
